Capital Work in Progress - 439,102 16,799 Investment property 143,804 296,732 145,894 Trading turnover for the 6 months declined by 13% largely attributed to the stronger shilling versus the US$, given that a major part of the business is in export markets. There was also softer demand for carbon dioxide in various markets in this period. Gross margin improved due to reduced Right-of-use asset 51,516 51,805 51,516 input costs, savings from solar installation and other focused cost saving initiatives. Administration cost increased by 7% driven by inflation and Equity investments 439,099 403,406 399,629 increased marketing costs to secure existing and additional business. Increased borrowing to finance the plant expansion and higher interest rates Corporate, treasury & money market bonds 1,808,684 1,978,934 1,893,961 have also contributed to the overall cost increases. 4,566,937 4,434,569 4,456,841 There was a gain on revaluation of equity investments due to recovery of the NSE market leading to better stocks valuation. Strengthening of the Working Capital Tanzania shilling also contributed to a higher value in DSE stocks. Current assets 1,483,376 836,728 1,821,482 Current liabilities (435,522) (358,879) (670,741) Other investments in the bonds, deposits and money market portfolios gave a stable return compared to prior year. Net working capital 1,047,854 477,849 1,150,741 Overall Group Profit after Tax decreased by 10% compared to the same period last year due to exchange rate impact on revenue. Total net assets 5,614,791 4,912,418 5,607,582 The US dollar shortages in some regional markets continue to impact demand negatively. The Board continues to look at options to cushion the EQUITY AND LIABILITIES business and recover revenue. Share Capital and Reserves Share capital 254,852 254,852 254,852 Dividend Capital reserves 10,825 32,941 10,825 A final dividend will be considered based on full year results.
